name: prayer squat yoga pose
description: A deep squat with palms together that opens the hips and inner thighs and builds ankle and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.
